newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday through overnight system repurchase agreements, market analysts said.

"We're looking for overnight systems," said Marilyn Schaja, money market economist at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette. "The (Federal) funds rate is indicating that there's a reserve need left and today is the last day of the (two-week reserve) maintenance period."
"We expect overnight systems," said James Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities Inc. "It's the last day of the maintenance period and the funds rate is kind of firm."
Federal funds were quoted at 5-7/16 percent in late morning trade, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate. -- Ellen Freilich, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1676
